capabilities: Add cover images, banners and icons to notes via dedicated properties
Color property values, list pills and tags, including past/present/future date colors
Hide individual or empty properties from the metadata block
Render number and text properties as progress bars
Transform displayed property values with Handlebars formatting templates
disambiguation: Not a properties editor; it only changes how existing properties are displayed in the note.
extras: Banner features may conflict with dedicated banner plugins (Pixel Banner, Simple Banner) and can be disabled per feature. The formatting-templates feature is described as experimental. Progress bars and custom date formats are not supported in bases (bases formulas are suggested instead). Property quick search works only on desktop.
intentEvidence: makes properties in notes and bases more visually appealing with images, colors and custom visual elements
problem: Obsidian's properties view renders metadata as plain pills with no visual customization, which is dull for notes like book profiles or people pages.
